title: One Piece
description: Monkey D. Luffy, a young man made of rubber after unintentionally eating a Devil Fruit, sets out to become the Pirate King and find the legendary treasure known as One Piece. Along the way, he assembles a diverse crew of pirates, each with their own dreams and backstories, and confronts the World Government, the Marines, and rival pirates.
author: Oda Eiichiro
